$schema.description: Path to this JSON Schema: editor autocomplete only, ignored by the loader.

id.description: The level id; equals the file name and the id of its geometry.

variant.description: The kind of level: it picks the timer icon and name.

durationMs.description: The level lasts this long, in sim ms; the timer ends it.

fromMs.description: The wave starts at this sim time, in sim ms. Strictly increasing from wave to wave.

maxSimultaneous.description: At most this many threats announced or open at once, a count of at least 1.

gapMinMs.description: Shortest sim time between two telegraphs of this wave, in sim ms.

gapMaxMs.description: Longest sim time between two telegraphs of this wave, in sim ms; at least `gapMinMs`.

lullMs.description: No new telegraph in the last stretch of the wave, in sim ms, so that it ends visibly. Below the wave length.

threats.description: The threats this wave adds to the pool. Waves are cumulative: wave `w` draws from waves `0..w`.

anchor.description: An anchor of the level geometry, without the `ANCHOR_` prefix.

items.description: One threat a wave adds: what, and where. An anchor is planned once in the level.
One wave of the escalation: from when, how many threats at once, how often, and what it adds.

waves.description: The waves of the level, in order. None: the level plans no threat.

objects.description: The interactive objects of the level (story 1.17); none by default.

id.description: The object id, the `objectId` of `TapObject`; unique in the level.

kind.description: What the object is: it decides what Papa does on arriving at it.

anchor.description: An anchor of the level geometry, without the `ANCHOR_` prefix.

items.description: One interactive object: what Space or A can walk Papa to, and where it stands.

gauges.description: The gauges of the level (story 1.19); none by default.

fatigue.description: Papa gets tired in this level. Absent: no fatigue, no gauge, no micro-sleep.

microSleepDef.description: The id of the `content/threats/<def>.json` Papa falls into when he is tired (`target: "papa"`).

feelOverrides.description: A partial `feel.json` merged over the base feel for this level only.

description: A level: its variant, its length, the waves of threats it plans and the objects it offers.
